title: Quantitative Mechanics & Computations
lede: Mathematical models, balance equations, combat resolutions, and procedural checks governing physical reality in EvoSim.

statCalculations.name: Maximum Health
statCalculations.example: An animal with Endurance 8 has Max Health = 100 + (8 * 10) = 180 HP.

statCalculations.name: Maximum Energy
statCalculations.example: An animal with Endurance 6 has Max Energy = 100 + (6 * 5) = 130 Energy.

actionCombat.name: Movement Energy Cost
actionCombat.example: Moving into Forest (1.5x) with Agility 6 costs (10 * 1.5) - (6 * 0.5) = 15 - 3 = 12 Energy.

actionCombat.name: Melee Combat Damage
actionCombat.example: Attacker STR 8 strikes defender AGI 5: (8 * 2) - 5 = 11 Damage inflicted.

actionCombat.name: Evasion Probability
actionCombat.example: Defender with Agility 7 has a 7 * 5% = 35% probability of totally evading an incoming strike.

actionCombat.name: Time Complexity
actionCombat.constants: Bounded spatial lookup on fixed 25x25 matrix
actionCombat.example: Single-step inference and state transition resolves in constant time.

passives.name: Ambush Predator Damage
passives.example: A base 12 damage strike becomes 12 * 1.5 = 18 lethal damage when ambushing.

passives.name: Efficient Grazer Sustenance
passives.example: Foraging vegetation restores 40 * 1.25 = 50 Hunger points instead of 40.

eventChecks.name: General Trait Difficulty Check
eventChecks.constants: d10 generates uniform random integer in [1, 10]
eventChecks.example: Rolling 6 with Trait 8 equals 14, succeeding against DC 12.

eventChecks.name: Contamination Save Check
eventChecks.example: Failure applies 5 HP poison tick per turn for 3 turns.
